surprises.head: Dallas buried San Jose in shots
surprises.body: San Jose takes fewer shots than almost anyone. Even by those standards, this was lopsided: Dallas took 57 of the 84 shot attempts at 5-on-5. From how these two usually play, Dallas would expect about 53%. A team strays this far about once every 90 games.

story.head: Oettinger shuts out the Sharks
paras: Miro Heiskanen got the scoring started for the Stars late in the first. Joel Kiviranta and Jamie Benn scored just over three minutes apart early in the second to stretch the lead to 3-0, and the Sharks had no answer. Jason Robertson made it 4-0 late in the period, and Mikko Rantanen stretched the lead to 5-0 with less than five minutes left.

The score was fair. Replay this game’s chances a hundred times and the Stars win about seven in ten. Jake Oettinger turned aside all 13 shots for the Stars, and Yaroslav Askarov stopped 21 of 26. The Stars improved to 1-2-0, and the Sharks dropped to 2-1-0.
